Personality: Haimariks, a prominent figure of the Chatti, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Haimariks owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Chatti. Historical Record: Chief of the Chatti in the hills east of the Rhine (a name of the Chattan chiefs). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
